HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Which programme is right for us?+

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, school, preschool, club or community organisation.

Do you offer more than football?+

Yes. Proteus works across a range of sports and activities, including basketball. Get in touch with your sport and the type of coaching you need so we can discuss a suitable option.

How do I express interest in the 2027 Academy?+

Email oliver@proteus.nz for football or isaac@proteus.nz for basketball. Include your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. The team will be in touch to discuss the next steps.

Where can I find holiday dates and registration details?+

Contact oliver@proteus.nz for upcoming holiday programmes, locations and registration information. Programme details vary, so check the information for the specific camp before booking.

How can our school or club work with Proteus?+

Contact patrick@proteus.nz with your organisation, the sport or activity, the group you want to support and your goals. We can discuss coaching and programme options that fit your needs.
